name: Fynbos Freight
trade: Road freight and courier, Western Cape to Gauteng
vat_number_note: None issued: a well-formed South African VAT number could belong to a real vendor. A test that needs one builds its own with a failing check digit and says so.
phone_note: Mail only: no number, so no test or video can dial a real line.

mailboxes.member_note: The live organisation 'Fynbos Freight' on app.isitlegit.co.za is owned by this member (signed up 2026-10-31 by the media lane).

people.note: Roles only, no invented personal names: a made-up name can still be a real person's.

hero_case: An 'updated banking details' invoice from a lookalike domain (fynbosfreight-payments.example) moves payment to a new Protea Bank account; IsItLegit flags the bank change against Fynbos Freight's protected identity and its account on file.
